impact.summary: Xcode iOS device support files: debug symbols copied from each connected iPhone/iPad OS version (~/Library/Developer/Xcode/iOS DeviceSupport/*).
impact.regeneration: Xcode copies the symbols again the next time a device with that OS version is connected (several minutes; the device is needed).
impact.offline_effect: Debugging on a device of that OS version waits for the symbols to be copied again. Archives, DerivedData and simulator devices are never matched.
